title: Four calendar actions have no UI: hold a plan, set a to-do's phase and time, and remove your own entry comment.

source.ref: Whole-site audit 2026-11-16 (project thread, requested by Daniel). Confidence: CONFIRMED. Audit file: audit/FINAL-BUILD-AND-REPAIR-LIST-2026-11-16.md

detail:
EVIDENCE: settings/calendar/plan-actions.ts:218 setPlanHold, task-actions.ts:222 setTaskPlanning, entry-record-actions.ts:136 removeEntryComment; none imported by a component. Pass-2 ledger says 'No UI yet: passes 3 to 9 build on it'. Holds cron (api/cron/calendar-holds) and the plan.hold_warning notification exist.

WHY IT MATTERS: Hold warnings and lapsed-hold release can never fire from the UI, and a member cannot take back a comment.

FIX DIRECTION: Wire each into the plan drawer and entry details, or park the backlog rows explicitly.

verify.note: Fails on 2026-11-16 (audit run). Passes when the fix lands. Audit-written probes are direction checks; retime only with Daniel's phrase.
